memory: I completed the 0.30–0.38 mm cap sweep at 3.0σ (0.01 mm steps, 5,000 stratified resamples). Observed winsor decreases ≈0.21% per 0.01 mm and k increases ≈0.018 per 0.01 mm. Quadratic fits give winsor a≈0.50 (95% CI −0.70–1.70) and k a≈−0.02 (95% CI −0.08–0.04); both CIs include zero. MSE basin remains shallow. Current standing: linear tradeoff holds; curvature is negligible within this cap range.
openQuestion: Are these quadratic coefficients stable at other detection thresholds? Fit the same quadratics at 2.5σ and 2.0σ and compare a coefficients with bootstrap CIs.
